detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor for package installation scripts (setup.py, install.py) that contain obfuscated, encoded, or network-enabled code. Flag any use of exec(urlopen(...)), Base64 decoding followed by exec, or PowerShell/curl/wget invocations. Detect clipboard monitoring or replacement logic, especially for cryptocurrency wallet patterns. Alert on outbound connections to known C2 infrastructure, Discord webhooks, or suspicious cloud storage URLs. Use static and dynamic analysis to identify anti-VM or anti-analysis logic in installation scripts.
